Hi=20Humberto,=20list,

I've=20never=20collected=20trapping=20web=20data,=20but=20I=20can=20perhap=
s=20give=20some=20useful=20
advice=20about=20how=20to=20put=20it=20into=20Distance.

Each=20web=20is=20equivalent=20to=20a=20single=20point=20in=20a=20point=20=
transect=20design.=20=20The=20
sample=20effort=20is=20the=20number=20of=20trapping=20events.=20=20Each=20=
trapped=20animal=20is=20
equivalent=20to=20an=20observation=20in=20a=20point=20transect.=20=20The=20=
distance=20of=20the=20trap=20
from=20the=20centre=20of=20the=20web=20is=20the=20distance=20to=20use=20fo=
r=20this=20"observation".

So,=20for=20example,=20say=20I=20had=201=20stratum=20of=20area=20100,=20co=
ntaining=202=20webs=20that=20I=20
used=20for=20two=20trapping=20events=20(say=20trap=20nights).=20=20I=20tra=
pped=203=20animals=20in=20the=20
first=20(at=20distances=203,=205,=207)=20and=202=20in=20the=20second=20(at=
=20distances=204,=205,=208)=20my=20
text=20file=20for=20data=20import=20might=20look=20like=20this:

area1=20100=20web1=202=203
area1=20100=20web1=202=205
area1=20100=20web1=202=207
area1=20100=20web2=202=204
area1=20100=20web2=202=205
area1=20100=20web2=202=208

Of=20course=202=20webs=20is=20not=20enough=20to=20make=20reliable=20infere=
nces=20about=20the=20stratum=20
density,=20nor=20is=206=20observations=20enough=20to=20reliably=20fit=20a=20=
detection=20function,=20
but=20you=20get=20the=20idea.

Perhaps=20others=20who=20actually=20*have*=20analyzed=20such=20data=20in=20=
Distance=20can=20send=20
you=20some=20real=20projects,=20rather=20than=20just=20advice!

Lots=20more=20about=20trapping=20webs=20is=20in=20section=206.8=20of=20the=
=20Introduction=20to=20
Distance=20Sampling=20book,=20and=20chapter=209=20of=20the=20Advanced=20bo=
ok=20discusses=20other=20
approaches=20such=20as=20trapping=20line=20transects.=20=20You=20may=20als=
o=20find=20the=20trapping=20
web=20simulation=20software=20WebSim=20written=20by=20Paul=20Lukacs=20usef=
ul=20in=20evaluating=20
the=20potential=20biases=20in=20your=20study=20
(http://www.cnr.colostate.edu/~plukacs/web.html)=20
If=20you=20get=20recapture=20information=20you=20may=20also=20want=20to=20=
consider=20using=20the=20
free=20software=20Density,=20by=20Murray=20Efford=20
(see=20http://www.landcareresearch.co.nz/services/software/density/=20and=20=

references=20on=20that=20page).

Hope=20this=20helps,

=20-=20Len
